contributions.anchor: Form A's own printed 'Total Contributions: (to line 1 of report): 3,873.35' on p17, equal to BOTH the cover summary's 'This Report' and 'Totals:' cells for line 1 (3,873.35)
contributions.detail: 6 printed Form A rows: 803.35 + 300.00 + 500.00 + 250.00 + 20.00 + 2,000.00 = 3,873.35, to the cent. The 2024 cover is the 3-LINE variant (a single 'Total contributions from all donors' cell, no separate <=$50 aggregate line), so the anchor is contrib_all and there is no line-1/line-2 residual. The 'Last Report' column is BLANK on this filing (it is the first report of the cycle, the '7 days before convention' box, covering transactions from January 1, 2024), so This Report == Totals and 'exact' is the right verdict.

itemized.notes: Four-page filing: p15 cover, p16 the summary block (the 2024 form runs the Last/This/Totals table onto the SECOND page), p17 Form A, p18 Form B. Both schedules are PORTRAIT typed sheets - Van Wagoner filled the county's fillable form rather than handwriting it - so the rows read top-to-bottom, unlike the rotated landscape schedules used elsewhere in this corpus. Donor STREET addresses printed on Form A are deliberately NOT carried (PRIVACY.md: donor_city / donor_state only). donor_state is recorded EXACTLY as the filer printed it, which on this sheet is 'Utah' spelled out on four rows and 'UT' on one; the Kerry Wayne row prints no state at all and is honestly blank - left empty by the filer, not redacted. The COUNTY's own redactions on this filing are on the COVER (p15: the candidate's street address and cell number are blacked out) and touch no schedule row. Report type box checked: '7 days before convention'.
